whenToUse: Assistant replies and agent output that stream code, or lines a reader picks to ask about
Code review of diffs, git patches and diagnostics, with accept, reject and fix actions
Docs snippets and terminal or test logs with line numbers, copy, wrap, folding and search

whenNotToUse.when: A full assistant conversation screen with thread list, transcript and composer
A discount or promo code shown for a shopper to copy at checkout
A release console with environment lanes, a deploy history grid and streaming logs

agentNotes: Line specs such as `highlightedLines`, `diff` and `folded` count source lines from 1, whatever `startLine` prints in the gutter
`maxLines` caps height only on the built-in surface; with `CodeBlockContent` inside your own `ScrollArea`, cap that viewport yourself
Hoist `transformers` to module scope; a new array on every render re-tokenizes the whole file
